# Bay Logistics is extending its network south with a new warehousing and distribution · 2026-08-05T00:00:00+00:00

Bay Logistics is extending its network south with a new warehousing and distribution
center opening in Murfreesboro, Tennessee this August — linking our Detroit and Flint
operations, the heart of Michigan's auto manufacturing, to Tennessee's growing
automotive economy. #newlocation #warehousing #logistics
